title: Fixed 3/3 MINOR issues from QA Round 1
body: Fixed 3/3 MINOR issues from QA Round 1: (1) Updated styleExportSheet JSDoc to document bandIds param, kind 4 band header styling, and BAND_TINT_PALETTE tint logic. (2) Added @param tags for all 4 enrichRowsWithBandHeaders parameters. (3) Removed unused getStore import from export-bands.test.ts. Typecheck: 0 errors. Lint: 0 errors (pre-existing warnings only). title: Fixed dead-code band tint bug: rowObj._band_id always undefined after remap()
body: Fixed dead-code bug in XLSX band tint: `getBandIndex(bandIds, rowObj._band_id)` at export.ts:475 always returned -1 because `remap()` strips `_band_id` from cleanRows (it's in XLSX_INTERNAL_COLS). Replaced with index-based lookup: `bandIds[r - 1]` to read from the parallel array directly. Removed the now-unused `getBandIndex` helper. Updated test fixtures to remove `_band_id` from cleanRows, matching production flow where band info comes exclusively from the `bandIds` parallel array. Key insight: tests passed before because fixtures manually included `_band_id` in cleanRows — a fixture/production mismatch that masked the bug.

title: Fixed 4 MINOR QA issues for Plan A ingestion
body:
Fixed 4 MINOR QA issues for TASK-column-type-aware-where-A-ingestion:

1. CONTRACTS.md line 73 — corrected inaccurate claim that CSV imports store no colTypes. scanCellTypes returns all-string records for CSV files, so the conditional spread DOES include them (redundant but harmless). Updated text to match actual behavior.

2. Added test: null header cell — verifies columns with v:null in header row are silently dropped from result.

3. Added test: sparse dense array — verifies null rows between data rows in dense arrays are skipped (exercises if (!row) continue at loader.ts:127).

4. Added test: all-skipped column — verifies columns with valid headers but all error/stub/null data cells are absent from result.

All verification passed: typecheck 0 errors, lint 0 warnings, 923/923 tests pass (52 files).

title: Fixed dead code + added test coverage for overlay-grouping.ts
body:
Fixed 2 MINOR issues from QA review round for TASK-detail-bands-overlay-B-grouping-layer:

1. Dead code fix: buildOverlayDescriptors() was calling makeKeyValue() directly instead of using GroupBoundaryDetector.getCurrentMatchValue(). Replaced direct call at line 176 with detector.getCurrentMatchValue(parentRow), removed now-unused bandKeyAliases map. getCurrentMatchValue() is now actually used, fulfilling its encapsulation purpose.

2. Created comprehensive test file overlay-grouping.test.ts with 11 tests covering: GroupBoundaryDetector state machine (first row, same key, different key), buildOverlayDescriptors edge cases (empty rows, no bands, single group, unique keys, multi-band, no matching children, disabled band, band without results, column propagation, label fallback, multi-group).

All 991 tests pass, 0 typecheck errors, 0 lint warnings.

title: Removed redundant type assertions in export.ts
body: Removed 4 redundant TypeScript type assertions in export.ts buildExportFromDescriptors(). After checking d.type === 'band-section' etc., TypeScript narrows the discriminated union automatically — the `as BandSectionDescriptor` / `as ParentDescriptor` / `as BandRowDescriptor` casts were unnecessary. Also removed the now-unused type imports (ParentDescriptor, BandSectionDescriptor, BandRowDescriptor). Typecheck and lint both pass clean.
